name: The Medinas of the Historic Sultanates of the Comoros
description: Six historic towns across the Comoros, an island chain in the Indian Ocean, make up this group of medinas. They began as small settlements around the 11th century and grew into city-states by the 14th–15th centuries, each the main town of its island's sultanate. Their layouts and buildings reflect Indian Ocean trade and migration, and the traditional social customs that shaped them are still practised today.
